subject: imaging server unreachable
body: X-ray workstations cannot reach the imaging server since 9am. Chairs 3 and 4 are idle, patients waiting. Front desk says a strange email about a password reset came in this morning too but they are not sure it is related.

subject: donor database export failing before board meeting
body: The quarterly donor export has failed twice with a timeout. The board meeting is tomorrow morning and the development director needs the giving report tonight.

subject: named-partner mailbox rejecting inbound mail
body: Atty. Osorio's mailbox has bounced three client emails since noon with a quota error. Filings go out today and opposing counsel says their replies are bouncing too.

expect.note: named-partner issues are P1 by contract

subject: line-side kiosk frozen on night shift
body: Kiosk 7 on the packing line is frozen and the night crew cannot log picks. Ramil is on site but cannot reach the kiosk admin share. Line is moving but paper-logging.

subject: user clicked a link in a weird email
body: One of the hygienists got an email that looked like our patient portal and clicked the link and typed her password before realizing it looked off. Everything seems fine now though.

expect.note: credential compromise, calm wording must not lower it

subject: printer acting up in the front office
body: The front office printer keeps printing pages of random characters on its own overnight. Also our antivirus flagged and quarantined something on the same machine yesterday but the printer is the annoying part.

expect.note: buried AV flag outweighs the printer framing

subject: Atty. Castro cannot open email on phone
body: Atty. Castro's phone keeps asking for a password for email since this morning and she is in hearings all day. Desktop access still works fine.

expect.note: named partner affected but desktop workaround exists

subject: new volunteer coordinator starts Monday
body: We have a new volunteer coordinator starting Monday and she will need an email account, access to the donor database read-only, and the shared calendar.

subject: nothing works, whole office offline
body: No internet, no phones, no imaging, nothing. Patients in the lobby. The modem lights are all dark after a power blip.

subject: computers feel slow lately
body: A few folks in the office mentioned their machines feel slower than usual the last couple weeks. No errors, nothing broken, just slow sometimes.

expect.note: vague report, low confidence is the honest answer

subject: strange message on the file server screen
body: The file server in the closet has a full-screen message saying our files are encrypted and to contact an email address to get them back. Nobody can open case files.

subject: badge reader logs show odd entries
body: Reviewing last month's door logs for the audit and there are badge entries at 3am on two Sundays from a badge belonging to someone who left the company in May.

expect.note: physical access anomaly with terminated credential
